name: Comet
description: Comet is a self-hosted service for torrent/debrid search with configurable environment variables and support for SQLite or PostgreSQL backends.

paths.name: Data Folder
paths.description: Persistent data directory for Comet application data.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Host port mapped to the Comet web service (container listens on 8000).

variables.name: Database URL
variables.description: Database target. For SQLite, use a file path in the Data Folder. For PostgreSQL, use host:port/database credentials format.
